title: Skyhills Casino Geluksrad — Champagne
concept_notes: Premium metallic frame with a clockwise animated circus-style bulb chase.
Bright glossy green center button with a gold bezel and controlled glow.
The green glazed glass button texture is derived from the supplied visual reference; live text remains HTML.
High-saturation ruby-red and luminous-gold sectors with strong contrast.
Currency and free-spin units are sized to 50 percent of their numeric values.
The crown is removed; the logo and Dutch two-line headline are shifted lower for a cleaner responsive composition.
Fluid spacing separates the logo from the headline and the wheel from the attempts card on desktop and mobile.
The center spin control is enlarged so its label remains fully legible on compact screens.
Retry and claim actions use the same green glazed-glass treatment and gold frame as the center control.
Local Manrope variable-font files provide smooth and consistent typography on every host.
The 100 and 4,000 values are reduced by 20% and share the same font size.
The bulb chase uses substantially brighter circular cores and a multi-stage yellow-gold halo without moving overlay layers.
The wheel rotor uses a dedicated compositor layer and the bulb chase animates opacity only for smoother frame pacing.
The responsive gap between the headline and wheel is increased.
The selector remains completely stationary while the wheel rotates beneath it.
Sector labels use taller line boxes, unclipped glyphs and softer shadows so descenders remain fully visible.
The fixed translucent winner-beam overlay is removed so no phantom sector appears during rotation.
Wheel values are enlarged by roughly 35 to 40 percent and labels by roughly 50 percent.
CSS-built wheel graphics remain crisp at every screen size.
Two-stage spin, popups, saved win state, conversion tracking and redirect are preserved.
The reward modal uses a champagne-gold fill with restrained burgundy-red accents for an A/B color test.
A small semicircle of card-suit icons adds casino character above the premium-reward label.
